 Bank Holiday Today: Check Where Banks Are Shut And Which Services Are Available
 Physical banking services are unavailable in the two cities on November 16, 2026, although customers can access mobile banking, Netbanking and ATM facilities
 O Outlook Money Curated by: Priyanka Debnath Updated on: 16 November 2026 1:29 pm Updated on: 16 November 2026 1:29 pm SUBSCRIBE 
 Bank Holiday Today Bank Holiday Today Summary of this article
 Bank branches in Patna and Ranchi are closed today.
 The closure is for Chhath Puja, as per RBI calendar.
 UPI, ATMs, mobile banking and online transfers are available.
 Bank branches in Patna and Ranchi are observing a holiday on November 16, 2026, on account of  Chhath Puja . The closure affects public and private sector banks in both cities.
 Customers who need to visit a branch for cash deposits, withdrawals, cheque-related work or document submissions will have to plan their visits around the holiday. However, online banking facilities and ATM services are accessible for routine financial transactions.
 Follow our WhatsApp channel Chhath Puja 2026: A Guide To EPFO, UAN, And PF Withdrawal For Workers 
 BY Priyanka Debnath 
 RBI Bank Holiday Calendar For November 2026 
 The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) holiday calendar includes 16 dates of bank closures in November. These cover Sundays, second and fourth Saturdays, as well as regional festivals and religious occasions. Festival-related holidays vary by location and do not apply uniformly across India.
 Banks were closed on November 1 and 8 for Sunday holidays. Regional closures followed on November 9, 10 and 11 in various cities for  Diwali -related celebrations,  Laxmi Puja ,  Govardhan Puja ,  Bali Pratipada ,  Bhai Dooj  and other local observances.
 On November 9, branches were shut in Agartala, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Gangtok, Imphal, Jaipur, Kanpur and Lucknow. On November 10, the holiday covered Ahmedabad, Belapur, Bengaluru, Dehradun, Gangtok, Mumbai and Nagpur. The November 11 closure applied to Gangtok, Imphal, Kanpur, Kolkata, Lucknow and Shimla.
 Shillong observed a bank holiday on November 13 for the  Wangala Festival. November 14 was the second Saturday closure, followed by the Sunday holiday on November 15. On November 16, branches in Patna and Ranchi are closed for  Chhath Puja .
 Continue Reading The remaining regional holidays include November 20 in Dehradun for  Igas-Bagwal  and November 23 in Shillong for  Seng Kut Snem .
 On November 24, banks are scheduled to close in Aizawl, Belapur, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chandigarh, Dehradun, Hyderabad, Itanagar, Jaipur, Jammu, Kanpur, Kohima, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, New Delhi, Raipur, Ranchi, Shimla and Srinagar for observances including  Guru Nanak Jayanti  and  Karthika   Purnima .
 Bengaluru will observe a holiday on November 27 for  KanakadasaJayanthi . The fourth Saturday closure falls on November 28, followed by the Sunday holiday on November 29.
 Which Banking Services Are Available On November 16 
 The closure of physical branches does not affect most digital banking facilities. Customers can use Unified Payments Interface (UPI), mobile banking applications and Netbanking to transfer money, make payments and check account details. 
 Other digital banking options, including NEFT and RTGS fund transfers, will work as usual today. Cash withdrawals are available at ATMs, and payments can be made using debit and credit cards.
 But, services that require a branch visit, such as some document submissions, locker related requests and account procedures will not be available at the closed branches. Customers should contact their banks for restrictions or planned outages on their services.
